about_short_description.short_description: XebiaLabs develops enterprise-scale Continuous Delivery and DevOps software.

product.name: Analytics & Intelligence
product.description: Provides insights and analytics to align product delivery with business strategy, streamline value streams, and improve application reliability using AI-powered intelligence.

product.name: Enterprise Agile Planning
product.description: Enables scaling of agile practices and provides insights across all organizational levels to drive efficient software development and delivery.

product.name: Application Protection & Security
product.description: Protects applications from attacks by providing visibility into ongoing threats and automating security responses.

product.name: Continuous Testing
product.description: Delivers scalable web and mobile testing with increased test coverage and visibility into application quality to ensure flawless customer experiences.

product.name: Release Orchestration
product.description: Automates and orchestrates software releases across complex technology environments to eliminate bottlenecks and improve governance.

product.name: Deployment Automation
product.description: Increases speed, reliability, and scalability of application deployments across all environments, including mainframes, VMs, containers, and cloud.
